# 261_R6FIX.11 — `handleProjectPurge` FK-cascade misses the NO-ACTION leaves (F-R7DEPMAIN-1 / BL-113)

## What

The re-armed `project.purge:01M3SK38…` **failed ×3 loudly** on prod 2026-11-15 ~20:10Z —
`delete from drafts … violates "claims_draft_id_fkey"` (23503). `handleProjectPurge` relied on
`delete from projects` cascading the tree, but a dozen project-tree edges are FK **NO ACTION**
(`confdeltype='a'`, verified verbatim against prod `pg_constraint` this run): the same defect the
sibling `handleAccountHardDelete` was fixed for on 2026-10-01. **Any project that ran a Review is
unpurgeable** — the original 10-30 armed job `57bbef6f` died on this exact throw silently; every
hourly sweep tick keeps re-arming and failing until this lands.

## Fix (the sibling's proven leaf-ordering, project-scoped)

`apps/worker/src/jobs.ts` — `handleProjectPurge` now deletes every NO-ACTION leaf explicitly
before the keyed `delete from projects`, in the order `handleAccountHardDelete` proves live:
`working_copies` (now covering `live_doc_id` too) → `provenance_maps` → `analytics_events` +
`inbox_items` (soft-ref hygiene) → `gates` → `decision_requests` → `obligation_findings` →
`revision_obligations` → `dispositions` → `findings` → `claims` → `correspondence_items` →
**self-FK sever pass** (`drafts.base_draft_id`, `runs.parent_run_id` nulled on surviving
cross-project rows only — both nullable; `ProjectPurgeResult.severed` reports the counts) → keyed
`delete from projects` → object-key cleanup (unchanged). Cascade-internal same-statement edges
(`drafts.promoted_version_id`, `runs.agent_instance_id`) resolve inside the keyed delete — the
sibling's 239 completions prove that ordering; they are enumerated in the comment for the complete
map. **No constraint touched, no sweep weakened — the fix is ordering, not dropping FK checks.**
